landing.badge: AI-grade SEO audits without the enterprise price tag
landing.subtitle: SEOKUB crawls your pages and gives you a prioritized, fix-it-today SEO report — a lighter, faster alternative to Ahrefs, Semrush and Moz.
landing.featuresTitle: One report. Every issue. Plain English.
landing.f1d: Titles, meta descriptions, headings, structured data, canonicals, mobile-friendliness and more — scored against current Google guidelines.
landing.f2d: We test your internal links as a crawler would and flag 404s, timeouts and redirect chains before Google finds them.
landing.f3d: Server response time is measured and scored — a direct Core Web Vitals driver.
landing.f4d: Open Graph and Twitter Card tags verified so every share looks professional.
landing.f5d: noindex traps, missing sitemap.xml and canonical mistakes caught automatically.
landing.f6d: Every issue is ordered by impact with a concrete recommendation, so you fix the biggest wins first.
landing.howTitle: From URL to action in under 30 seconds
landing.s1d: One URL, one click. No credit card, no 14-day trial countdown.
landing.s2d: Our engine fetches your page, runs 20+ checks and calculates a 0–100 health score.
landing.s3d: Apply the recommendations, re-audit, and watch your score climb.
landing.ctaTitle: Your first audit is on us
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join the waitlist for the free launch tier — unlimited audits for 30 days.
